The exact first-visit interval has length 1/2-s, giving S1=1/4. Two-step dynamics preserves t and translates y by ±(1-4s) mod1. The explicit two-visit intervals and restriction from four visits rule out additional mod-one wraps, so repeated intersection successively clips one endpoint: the even/odd surviving widths are triangular with apex 1/4 and roots ((k-1)/(4k-3), k/(4k-1)) and ((2k-1)/(2(4k-1)),(2k+1)/(2(4k+1))) respectively. Both sides contribute equally; triangle integration yields S_2k=(2k-1)/(4(4k-1)(4k-3)), S_(2k+1)=k/(2(16k²-1)), hence n S_n→1/16. Initial A3 probability 1/4 gives Pr(tau>=n)=4S_n, first exit =4(S_n-S_(n+1)), divergent mean. Boundary/singularity fibers are null. Independently checked 98 rational triangle/base area identities; examined the original-map integer grid comparator for up to 13 visits. Exact all-n result rests on the fiber-induction proof, not numerical agreement.
